entries.en: The historian compared the old ammophoska order with the farm's fertiliser accounts.
entries.zh: 那位历史研究者把安福钾的旧订单与农场肥料账目作了比较。

entries.en: The historian questioned the assumptions behind the doctor's description of the amnemonic patient.
entries.zh: 那位历史研究者质疑了那名医生将患者描述为记忆障碍者时所依据的假设。

entries.en: The embryologist compared the amnia in the two sets of developmental drawings.
entries.zh: 那位胚胎学家比较了两组发育图画中的羊膜。

entries.en: The student enlarged the amniochorial region in her anatomical drawing.
entries.zh: 那名学生在解剖图中放大了羊膜与绒毛膜所在的区域。

entries.en: The lecturer compared the amnioembryonic diagrams in two early textbooks.
entries.zh: 那位讲师比较了两本早期教科书中的羊膜胚示意图。

entries.en: The embryologist compared the account of amniogenesis with the accompanying developmental drawings.
entries.zh: 那位胚胎学家把关于羊膜形成的记述与所附的发育图画作了比较。

entries.en: The medical historian examined the early amniography report without endorsing the procedure.
entries.zh: 那位医学史研究者考察了那份早期羊水造影报告，并未认可这种操作。

entries.en: The case discussion compared the reported amnioma with the accompanying tissue photographs.
entries.zh: 那次病例讨论把报告中的羊膜瘤与所附的组织照片作了比较。

entries.en: The reviewer asked whether the report of amnionitis had distinguished observations from assumptions.
entries.zh: 审稿人询问，那份羊膜炎报告是否区分了观察结果与假设。

entries.en: The historian compared the early amnioplastin reports with the hospital's purchasing records.
entries.zh: 那位历史研究者把早期干羊膜制剂报告与医院采购记录作了比较。

entries.en: The clinician questioned how the time of amniorrhexis had been established in the case report.
entries.zh: 那位临床医生质疑，病例报告是如何确定羊膜破裂时间的。

entries.en: The historian compared the old amnioscopy illustrations with the surviving instrument catalogue.
entries.zh: 那位历史研究者把旧的羊水镜检法插图与留存的器械目录作了比较。

entries.en: The historian examined two early accounts of amniosis without assuming that their diagnoses were equivalent.
entries.zh: 那位历史研究者考察了两份关于羊膜炎的早期记述，没有预先假定其中的诊断等同。

entries.en: The review compared the historical descriptions of amniotitis with the original case notes.
entries.zh: 那篇综述把关于羊膜炎的历史记述与原始病例笔记作了比较。

entries.en: The museum's amniotome was displayed beside a drawing from an old instrument catalogue.
entries.zh: 博物馆收藏的羊膜穿破器与一幅来自旧器械目录的图摆在一起展出。

entries.en: The review separated reports of amniotomy from descriptions of spontaneous membrane rupture.
entries.zh: 那篇综述把羊膜穿破术的报告与胎膜自发破裂的记述分开讨论。

entries.en: The historian questioned the evidence behind the early diagnosis of amnitis.
entries.zh: 那位历史研究者质疑了早期那项羊膜炎诊断所依据的证据。

entries.en: The researcher compared the old Amobam analysis with its original laboratory notes.
entries.zh: 那位研究者把那份代森铵旧分析报告与原始实验室笔记作了比较。

entries.en: The reviewer asked whether the amodiaquin discussion accurately reflected the cited studies.
entries.zh: 审稿人询问，关于氨酚喹的讨论是否准确反映了所引用的研究。

entries.en: The pharmacist checked the amodiaquine recorded in the medication history before speaking with the patient.
entries.zh: 那位药剂师先核对了用药史中记录的阿莫地喹，随后才与患者交谈。

entries.en: The archivist found an unpaid Amodyn invoice among the factory's wartime papers.
entries.zh: 档案员在工厂的战时文件中找到了一张尚未支付的阿莫丁炸药发票。

entries.en: The reviewer questioned the evidence used to describe the extract as an amoebacide.
entries.zh: 审稿人质疑了将该提取物描述为杀变形虫剂时所采用的证据。

entries.en: The zoologist compared the Amoebidae drawings with the specimens described in the old catalogue.
entries.zh: 那位动物学家把阿米巴科的图画与旧目录所述的标本作了比较。

entries.en: The historian compared the early illustrations of Amoebobacter with the original observations.
entries.zh: 那位历史研究者把阿米巴细菌属的早期插图与原始观察记录作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 阿米巴样细菌族〔旧分类名称〕
entries.en: The microbiologist compared the organisms grouped under Amoebobacterieae in the old classification.
entries.zh: 那位微生物学家比较了旧分类中被归入阿米巴样细菌族的那些生物。

entries.en: The student enlarged the amoebocyte in the lower corner of the slide photograph.
entries.zh: 那名学生把切片照片下方角落里的阿米巴样细胞放大了。

entries.en: The parasitologist compared the Amoebotaenia drawings with the museum's preserved specimens.
entries.zh: 那位寄生虫学家把变形带绦虫属的图画与博物馆保存的标本作了比较。

entries.en: The student drew the amoebula beside a scale bar in her notebook.
entries.zh: 那名学生在笔记本的比例尺旁画了这个小阿米巴。

entries.en: The chemist compared the amoil spectrum with the figure in the original report.
entries.zh: 那位化学研究者把酞酸戊酯谱图与原始报告中的图作了比较。

entries.en: The researcher requested the original amolanone measurements before reviewing the proposed structure.
entries.zh: 那位研究者要求先查看阿莫拉酮的原始测量结果，再审查所提出的结构。
